knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure separates daily high-touch work from periodic tasks, sequences around occupancy and drying time, and escalates conflicts rather than silently omitting work.
Unclear scope or access is escalated, and the worker does not silently omit contracted work or improvise.
The workplace procedure says to separate daily high-touch work from periodic tasks and special requests.

practicalCriteria: Creates a realistic prioritised plan, preserves contracted scope and flags capacity or access conflicts early.
Recognises and escalates unsafe or out-of-scope work
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 1: Read the signed scope and site schedule for areas, frequency, timing, service standard, exclusions, permitted chemicals and required records.
Record of procedure step 7: Record out-of-scope requests and obtain approval before adding them to the shift.
Record of procedure step 8: Escalate any conflict between the schedule and safe completion, and do not silently omit work.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 8 is not done: Escalate any conflict between the schedule and safe completion, and do not silently omit work.
